assets.procedure: Use only your built-in image generation tool, not code drawing or web images. Generate one high-resolution photorealistic synthetic contact sheet arranged as exactly 4 columns by 4 rows with equal rectangular cells and no gutters, labels, borders, text or logos. Every cell must be a distinct complete photo, no objects cross cell boundaries. Row1: four small clothing-shop interiors featuring respectively a blue jacket with three other garments, a striped shirt with three other garments, a gray coat and red sweater with two other garments, jeans and brown shoes laid flat separately. Row2: three distinct fictional storefronts (blue awning, brick facade, green door, absolutely no writing) then brown shoes alone against white. Row3: full body front view synthetic adult woman with long hair plain fitted neutral clothing feet fully visible; full body front view synthetic adult man with hat plain fitted clothing feet fully visible; adult halfbody with legs outside photo; adult with scarf hiding neck. Row4: two adults together; adult with head cropped by image edge; empty clothes hanger against wall with no person; empty shop with a mannequin-like coat stand but no person. Each portrait must have its own plain background and entire cell framing. These are fabricated adults not real people and fixtures for privacy testing. Save the generated image file into verification/fixtures/source/contact-sheet.png under current directory. Do not edit any code or other files. Report the actual output path and image tool used.
